headline: Gap Lowers Annual Forecasts Citing Sluggish Pre-Holiday Apparel Demand
summary: Gap trimmed its full-year financial outlook as consumer spending on apparel softened ahead of the critical holiday shopping season.
why: Gap operates prominent retail brands including Old Navy, Banana Republic, and Athleta, offering key insight into US consumer discretionary health.

impacts.name: The Gap, Inc.
impacts.why: Cutting revenue and profit targets ahead of the key holiday quarter indicates softening retail demand.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Gap shares faced downward pressure after the retailer lowered its guidance due to weak consumer demand.
